title: Read a note by ID
body:
Add a note retrieval endpoint to the existing HTTP service.

- R1: GET /notes/{id} returns status 200 and the exact JSON note created by POST /notes.
- R2: Unknown or nonnumeric IDs return status 404 with a JSON error.
- R3: Retrieving one note does not alter the existing ordered GET /notes response. Add repository HTTP E2E tests.
